name: Denisha
bio: Denisha (born 2004) is a talented young Indonesian actress and model who is quickly making her mark in the entertainment industry. Rising to prominence as the 2nd Runner-Up of GADIS Sampul 2021, she seamlessly transitioned from a celebrated modeling background into a compelling on-screen performer. Known for her natural acting ability and screen presence, Denisha has starred in notable feature films, independent shorts, and popular music videos. With her striking features, dedication, and growing portfolio, she stands out as one of Indonesia’s most promising and versatile new generation of actors.
